heroHeadline: Iran MOU Stalled as Trump Tightens Terms — Pezeshkian Denies IRGC Takeover Resignation Reports
heroSubtitle: From Cyrus the Great's Achaemenid Empire (550 BCE) through the 1979 Islamic Revolution to the post-war Islamic Republic under Mojtaba Khamenei — now at its most critical juncture: President Pezeshkian publicly denied June 1 reports that he submitted a resignation letter citing IRGC domination, while the US State Department confirmed back-channel dialogue with Iran continues even as Trump sent significantly toughened MOU terms demanding stricter nuclear guarantees, explicit HEU transfer timelines, and unconditional Hormuz reopening — with the ceasefire extension nearing its mid-June expiry.
